meta.title: Manage Line Items: Save fails when price contains special characters
gaps: The case does not provide a specific product, so selecting the intended product from the product dropdown cannot be verified.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The case does not provide a specific product, so selecting the intended product from the product dropdown cannot be verified.

steps.note: Open the existing saved draft; the draft reopens on its create screen.
Open the Manage Line Items window for the draft's existing line item.
Enter the requested quantity in the first line item.
Enter the special-character price value being tested.
Attempt to save the edited line item.
Assert that Procol refuses the invalid price or reports an error after the save attempt.
Verify that the special-character price was not accepted by the sheet.
